rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for announcing or declaring something publicly.

example.english: I proclaim that the whole company will be off tomorrow!
example.traditional: 我而家宣布，聽日全公司放假！
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 syun1 bou3 ting1 jat6 cyun4 gung1 si1 fong3 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when an official person or organization makes information public, especially a decision, result, or policy.

example.english: The committee will proclaim the results of this year's competition.
example.traditional: 大會公布今屆比賽結果。
example.jyutping: daai6 wui6 gung1 bou3 gam1 gaai3 bei2 coi3 git3 gwo2
